limits.json_memory_budget: minimum of 64 MiB and one eighth of available Java heap

snapshot.database_format: logical SQLite snapshot with typed values, schema and sqlite_sequence; no raw live .db copy
snapshot.source_transaction: same transaction as replacement; snapshot verification/publication before first live deletion
verification: SHA-256 and size of every recorded file
isolated fresh-context recovery with exact attachment/index comparison
snapshot.retention: previous verified snapshots are never automatically removed
snapshot.credentials: PIN/account tokens omitted; live credentials unchanged

64 MiB tests run in separate JVMs, not an Android low-memory device.
I/O/space failures injected; no actual disk-full or physical power-cut test.
Android provider, CursorWindow and connection pool require device checks.
